subject: Multi-region pilot: packaging and discount clarification
messages:
From: Hannah Li <hannah.li@atlascare.com>
To: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Multi-region pilot — packaging and discount question

Hi Ben,

Thanks for the demo last week. We're putting together internal procurement notes for a small pilot (3 regions: US West, US East, EU) and want to understand packaging options. Rough requirements: ~50k tokens/month in month 1, 100k tokens/month after ramp, VPC option, regional replication for low latency, and audit logs for SOC2.

Questions:
- Which Redwood plan most closely maps to what we've been discussing (feature/limit differences)?
- Do you have a packaged add-on for multi-region replication or is that custom pricing?
- Any flexibility on pilot discounts if we convert to a 12-month commit after the pilot?

Would appreciate a short note with options (and any attachments) — happy to take a quick call if easier.

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Li
Head of Platform, AtlasCare
hannah.li@atlascare.com

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Li <hannah.li@atlascare.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Multi-region pilot — packaging and discount question

Hi Hannah — great to hear from you and glad the demo was helpful. Short answers up front, then an attachment with more detail. (Attached: pricing_grid_v2.xlsx, multiregion_addon.pdf)

Options that fit your requirements:

1) Growth plan (recommended for this pilot) — includes higher concurrency, prefix caching, standard audit logs, and model routing. Good for teams ramping from 50k to 100k tokens.

2) Enterprise (if you need strict SLA and dedicated capacity) — includes VPC Private deployment, extended retention for logs, and an SLA for cross-region failover.

Multi-region replication: we offer a Multiregion Add-on (see attached spec). It's typically a priced add-on on top of Growth/Enterprise. For pilots we can offer a temporary bundled SKU.

Pilot discount approach I can propose: 25% off list for the first 3 months for the Growth+Multiregion bundle if you agree to a conversion discussion by month 3. If you sign a 12-month commit immediately, we can extend a 12% ongoing discount instead.

Next steps: I can send a draft pilot SOW and a short quote. Do you have 30 minutes tomorrow (Wed) to go over the exact traffic profile so we can size the regional configs?

—Ben
Ben Carter | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0182

From: Hannah Li <hannah.li@atlascare.com>
To: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 13:40:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Multi-region pilot — packaging and discount question

Thanks Ben. A couple quick clarifications before we schedule:
- Is 'Growth' inclusive of model variant access (e.g., 7B/13B vs 70B), or is that an Enterprise-only feature?
- We need audit logs to be downloadable for our compliance team — does Growth provide exportable logs?
- The 25% pilot discount — is that also applicable if we do a pilot across multiple product teams within AtlasCare (i.e., multiple projects under the same account)?

If you can confirm these 3 points I can pull in procurement and we can lock a time.

—Hannah

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Li <hannah.li@atlascare.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 08:55:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Multi-region pilot — packaging and discount question

Hi Hannah — looping in Laura and Marissa to confirm the operational side and pilot terms. Quick answers:

- Model variants: Growth includes access to our curated set of open models (7B/13B). Access to larger 70B variants is typically included in Enterprise or as a metered add-on; we can make the 70B available for the pilot with a usage cap.
- Audit logs: Growth includes audit logging; exports (CSV/JSON) are available but retention is limited to 90 days. Enterprise provides longer retention and advanced export controls.
- Pilot across multiple internal projects: yes, we can consolidate projects under one pilot account. The 25% pilot discount would apply to the consolidated usage for the pilot period.

Internal note: proposed commercial path — Growth + Multiregion Add-on + Audit-logs retention bump (90->180 days as a limited pilot add-on). I'll draft a Pilot SKU and SOW. Attaching DRAFT_SOW_AtlasCare.pdf for reference.

Laura / Marissa — can you confirm internal approval for: 1) 25% off for first 3 months for the pilot SKU, 2) ability to enable 70B variant with a capped usage, and 3) a one-time extension to 180 days retention for audit logs for the pilot?

Thanks,
Ben

From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Multi-region pilot — packaging and discount question

Ben / Marissa — approve the pilot terms with the following guardrails:

1) Pilot discount: approve 25% for first 3 months for Growth+Multiregion bundle.
2) 70B access: allow as a metered trial with a strict cap (set by AE) and pre-approval for any overage.
3) Audit logs retention: extend to 180 days for the pilot only; do not change baseline Enterprise retention without procurement review.
4) Add explicit success criteria in the SOW (latency targets per region, usage thresholds, and conversion timeline), and cap monthly spend at $X (we will insert numbers on the quote) to prevent billing surprises.

Ben — please include the success criteria and the spend cap in the SOW before sending to AtlasCare. Marissa — can you prepare the pilot SKU (Growth+Multiregion+Audit-180d) and a draft quote in HubSpot?

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai

2) Share the DocuSign/contract link or a redline-friendly PDF so our legal team can review.
